description: Publishes a privacy-minimized snapshot of active Iowa Secretary of State entities from the official monthly Iowa Data Hub archive, preserving source-defined home-office evidence, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Reject archive and metadata redirects. For columns.json only, accept one manually validated HTTPS redirect to the exact Iowa Data Hub storage.googleapis.com dataset-554 columns object; never retain or log the signed query string.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry unexpected redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, duplicate identity, source refresh drift, archive-layout drift, row-count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Write a safe preflight snapshot before acquisition, retain the complete archive in run-scoped staging, derive and hash a business-only selected-field snapshot before normalization, and recheck live metadata and schema before publication. A complete staged archive can be revalidated and normalized into a new immutable run, and a complete unpublished manifest can be independently verified and published by immutable run ID. current.json changes only after verification and atomic release publication.
idempotency: The source modifiedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the official archive identify a source release; the six-digit Iowa corporation number creates one stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network and record processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis or resume, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal source archives and approved public business-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
